title: The inequality (⋆), the one-sided bound for the remainder of the weighted prime sum, the generalised Riemann hypothesis, and the passage to the critical line
summary: The top of the argument. (⋆): for admissible data D, m·rem ≤ (log b)²·𝓑, from Theorems A–B (a long independent family of rows of small index with short lifts) against Theorem C (the covolume is at least the main amount). The one-sided bound: R_{d,N₀}(x) ≤ x^(8ε − 1/2) for large x, by choosing the second scale x₁ in a window where R_{N₀} − (towerDeg/#thick)·R₁ is tiny and writing R_{N₀}(x) through rem. GRH: a zero right of 1/2 is excluded by the one-sided criterion (Landau) applied to the class N₀/2 − 1 modulo N₀ = 18480q. Then the functional equation gives the zeros on the critical line, for Dirichlet L-functions and for ζ.
notation: For parameters P: N₀ = P.N₀, d = P.d. For admissible data D (Lean `Data P`): x_D = D.x, x₁_D = D.x₁, b_D = D.b (with log b_D = D.logB), m_D = D.m, a_D = D.a, f_D = D.f, s_D = D.s, thick(D), tops(D), rows(D) = D.rows, dim rows(D) = D.rowDim, h_main(D) = D.mainHeight, rem(D) = D.remainder, 𝓑(D) = D.budget, Θ_D(ϑ) = D.Θ ϑ. R_{d,M}(x) = primeError d M x; L̃(s, χ) = entireL χ s; L(s, χ) = DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s.

members.name: star_inequality
members.text: The inequality (⋆). For parameters P and admissible data D for P (Lean's `Data P`): m_D·rem(D) ≤ (log b_D)²·𝓑(D), where m_D = D.m is the number of theta lifts, rem(D) = D.remainder is the remainder of the weighted prime sum (unit 151: the sum over the tops τ of D.primeSum(a_D, τ) − D.mainAsk), b_D = exp(D.logB) is the third scale of D, and 𝓑(D) = D.budget = f_D·a_D·(log b_D)³ is the error budget (f_D the number of infinite places of the field E of D, a_D = D.a the least multiple of N₁ that is at least x_D·b_D).

members.name: eventually_primeError_le_rpow
members.text: One-sided bound. For parameters P, with N₀ = P.N₀ and the prime d = P.d, and for every real ε with 0 < ε/6 and ε < 1/100 (hypothesis h): for all sufficiently large real x (Lean's ∀ᶠ x in atTop: there is X₀ such that the bound holds for every x ≥ X₀), R_{d,N₀}(x) ≤ x^(8ε + 1/2 − 1), that is x^(8ε − 1/2); here R_{d,N₀}(x) = primeError d N₀ x is the remainder of the smoothed sum ∑_{ν ≤ x, ν ≡ 1 mod N₀} Λ(ν)(1 − (ν/d))(1/ν − 1/x) over the integers ν ≡ 1 mod N₀, prime powers included (at a prime p with (p/d) = −1 the factor 1 − (ν/d) is 2 at odd powers of p and 0 at even ones; wording corrected after the second reading, a second-reader message) (unit 151), and x^y is the real power.

imports.name: Data.exists_family_covolumeSq_le
imports.lean:
lemma Data.exists_family_covolumeSq_le (D : Data P) : ∃ n, ∃ y : Fin n → _, LinearIndependent ℂ y ∧
    (1 - 4 / D.b ^ 2) * D.rowDim ≤ n ∧
  (∃ δ ≤ 5 * D.rowDim * log (1 + D.b ^ 2) * D.budget, D.IndexLe y δ) ∧ ∀ σ,
  covolumeSq (D.Θ 1 ∘ y) σ ≤ exp (n * (D.mainHeight - D.m * D.remainder + D.logB * D.budget)) := by
imports.text: (Theorems A and B together.) For admissible data D there are a natural number n and rows y : Fin n → rows(D), linearly independent over ℂ, with (1 − 4/b_D²)·dim rows(D) ≤ n, with IndexLe(D, y, δ) for some δ ≤ 5·dim rows(D)·log(1 + b_D²)·𝓑(D), and with squared covolume of the untwisted lifts Θ_D(1)∘y at most exp(n·(h_main(D) − m_D·rem(D) + log b_D·𝓑(D))) at every automorphism σ of ℂ.

imports.name: Data.IndexLe
imports.lean:
def Data.IndexLe {n} (y : Fin n → D.rows) δ := ∃ e : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ U, ∑ l ∈ U, e l ≤ δ) ∧
  ∀ l [Fact l.Prime] (ι : PadicPlace l) ϑ, l.Coprime ϑ.levelNorm → ∃ u :
  Matrix _ _ embValRing, (-e l).exp ≤ ‖ιₚ u.det‖ ∧ ∀ i, D.Θ ϑ (∑ k, u i k • y k) ∈ integralForms ι
imports.text: IndexLe(D, y, δ) for rows y : Fin n → rows(D) and a real δ: some function e from primes to reals has ∑_{l∈U} e(l) ≤ δ for every finite set U, and for every prime l, every embedding ι above l and every twist ϑ with l prime to the level of ϑ there is an integral matrix u at ι with |det u|_ι ≥ exp(−e(l)) such that every row ∑_k u_{ik}·y_k has ι-integral lift Θ_D(ϑ)(∑_k u_{ik}·y_k).

lemma isPolar_primeError (hd : d % 8 = 7) (h : M.Coprime d) : IsPolar (primeError d M ·.exp) fun s ↦
    (∑ ξ, (analyticOrderNatAt (@entireL M _ ξ) s - analyticOrderNatAt (entireL (quadTwist ξ d))
  s : ℂ)) / φ M / (s * (1 - s)) := by

imports.name: Data
imports.lean:
structure Data (P : Parameters) where
  /-- `logX = log x`, `logB = log b`, `logX₁ = log x₁`: the sizes are chosen on the logarithmic
  scale. -/
  (logX logB logX₁ : ℝ) (s m r : ℕ) s_le : s ≤ 32 * logX
  thick : Finset _
  g : Fin 2 → ℕ
  piG : 𝓞 P.K
  scale : 1e12 * P.c ≤ log logB ∧ 100 * log logB ≤ logX ∧ 1e6 * logX ≤ logX₁ ∧ 1e6 * logX₁ ≤ logB ∧
    6 * log logX₁ ≤ log logB
  m_mem : ↑m ∈ Icc (exp (logX / 2)) (2 * exp (logX / 2))
  r_mem : ↑r ∈ Icc (exp (5 * logX)) (3 * exp (5 * logX))
  m_pow : ∃ e, m = 2 ^ (e + 1) ∧ s = (e + 1) * 22
  r_pow : ∃ e, r = 3 ^ (e + 1)
  thick_eq_neg_one_mod {m} (d : m ∣ P.N₁ s) : m ∣ P.N₀ * 3 ^ (.log 3 s + 5) → ∀ σ ∈ thick, P.placeClass d σ = -1
  three_term : let φ := P.placeClass P.two_pow_dvd_N₁; ∀ i j, 0 < i → i < j → j ≤ 324 * s →
         ∀ σ ∈ thick, ∀ τ ∈ thick, ∀ ρ ∈ thick, φ (τ / σ) ^ j = φ (ρ / σ) ^ i → φ (τ / σ) = 1
  g_prime i : (g i).Prime
  g_modEq_one i : g i ≡ 1 [MOD P.N₁ s * P.d]
  dvd_g_sub_one i : P.Mω s ^ 2 ∣ g i - 1
  g_injective : g.Injective
  g_mem i : ↑(g i) ∈ Icc (exp logB ^ 10) (exp logB ^ 11)
  norm_piG : piG * star piG = g 0 * g 1
  exists_prime_window : ∀ U ∈ Icc (100 * logB) (2 ^ s), ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD P.Mω s ^ 2] ∧
    log p ∈ Icc U (U + √logB)
imports.text: Admissible data for parameters P (the structure Data P): real numbers log x, log b, log x₁ and natural numbers s, m, r with s ≤ 32·log x; a finite set thick of infinite places of E(P, s); a map g : {0, 1} → ℕ; an integer π_g of K(P); subject to: (scale) 10¹²·c(P) ≤ log log b, 100·log log b ≤ log x, 10⁶·log x ≤ log x₁, 10⁶·log x₁ ≤ log b and 6·log log x₁ ≤ log log b (the only conditions that mention log x₁); √x ≤ m ≤ 2√x and x⁵ ≤ r ≤ 3x⁵, where x = exp(log x); m = 2^(e+1) and s = 22(e + 1) for some natural e, and r = 3^(e′+1) for some natural e′; (class condition) for every divisor m′ of N₁(P, s) with m′ ∣ N₀·3^(⌊log₃ s⌋+5), every place σ ∈ thick has class −1 modulo m′; (three-term condition) with φ the class of a place modulo the power of 2 dividing N₁(P, s) given by `P.two_pow_dvd_N₁`: for all naturals 0 < i < j ≤ 324·s and all σ, τ, ρ ∈ thick, φ(τ/σ)^j = φ(ρ/σ)^i implies φ(τ/σ) = 1; g₀ = g(0) and g₁ = g(1) are distinct primes with g_i ≡ 1 mod N₁(P, s)·d, M_ω(P, s)² ∣ g_i − 1 and b¹⁰ ≤ g_i ≤ b¹¹, where b = exp(log b); π_g·π̄_g = g₀g₁; (prime windows) for every real U with 100·log b ≤ U ≤ 2^s there is a prime p ≡ 1 mod M_ω(P, s)² with U ≤ log p ≤ U + √(log b). (Completed after the writer of Chapter I found s ≤ 32·log x and M_ω² ∣ g_i − 1 missing; read against AdmissibleData.lean, lines 22–45.)

lemma entireL_ne_zero_of_primeError_le {M} [NeZero M] {a : ZMod M} {β} (hβ : 1 / 2 < β)
  (ha : IsUnit a) (h : ∀ d : Primes, d = a → (d.1 % 8 = 7 ∧ M.Coprime d) ∧ ∀ᶠ x in atTop, primeError
  d M x ≤ x ^ (β - 1)) ρ (hρ : β < ρ.re) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) : entireL χ ρ ≠ 0 := by

lemma LFunction_changeLevel {M N : ℕ} [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (hMN : M ∣ N)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {s : ℂ} (h : χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) :
    LFunction (changeLevel hMN χ) s =
      LFunction χ s * ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, (1 - χ p * p ^ (-s)) := by
